lede: Brent fell more than 7% on Monday on signs of US–Iran diplomacy, giving gold its best day in two months and nudging the dollar lower. The RBA lifted rates to an 18-year high this morning as Americans vote in the midterm elections.
snapshot_time: Gold ≈03:30 TRT · FX, S&P 500, Brent: Mon close

focus.text: Holding near $3,950 after Monday's 1.9% jump, its strongest day in two months, as the oil slump eased inflation fears. Midterm results overnight are the main risk; $3,978 is first resistance.
Back near 1.1200 from 17-month lows as the dollar softened with oil, but still under 1.1269 resistance. US JOLTS (18:00 TRT) and the midterms today; eurozone flash CPI on Wednesday.

technicals.indicators: RSI(14) ≈ 37 · below 100-day SMA (≈4,210) · 4h RSI back to mid-40s
technicals.note: A sharp rebound from the one-year low near $3,870, but price is still below all key moving averages and the former $4,000 floor sits overhead.

technicals.indicators: Below 55-day EMA · daily bias neutral inside 1.1114–1.1267 range
technicals.note: Ranging after the fall from 1.2081; the broader decline stays intact while 1.1269 caps rebounds, with 1.1100 the floor being tested.

technicals.indicators: Fear & Greed 37 (Fear) · below the October high near 87,000
technicals.note: Consolidating in a narrow band above the 76,000 floor after the Binance hack sell-off; the lower-high sequence since October is unbroken.

technicals.indicators: Price pinned under 2,300 · heavy weekly ETF outflows
technicals.note: Sideways just below the 2,300–2,330 ceiling, with 2,200 the nearest base after last week's drop.

news.text: Brent settled 7.6% lower at $104.77 on Monday as Washington and Tehran signalled openness to talks; Trump said he is in no rush to restart the war.
Australia's central bank raised its cash rate to 4.85%, the highest since 2008, but three members dissented and no further hikes were signalled.
Bullion rose about 1.9% on Monday, its biggest gain in two months, recovering part of October's 6.8% loss as lower oil eased inflation worries.
ISM manufacturing climbed to 55.5 against 54.5 expected, keeping December Fed hike odds near 73–75%; construction spending fell 1.9%.
S&P 500 slipped 0.5% and Nasdaq 1.1% as a $115B Marvell–Lumentum deal and Oracle's $20B raise revived AI-spending worries; Apple beat after hours.
Binance published a zero-knowledge reserve snapshot covering 10 assets including BTC, ETH, USDT and BNB; another snapshot follows Wednesday.
The exchange says about 95% of hacked assets are replenished and more networks reopen for withdrawals from Tuesday.
Binance's daily net outflows eased to roughly $3.3B, less than half the ~$7B peak, according to DeFiLlama data.
Elliptic says about $3.2B remains at theft-linked addresses; roughly $240M was laundered through TRON and 233M XRP moved to new wallets.
Spot bitcoin ETFs saw a net $203M outflow over 26–30 Oct; IBIT took in $177M while FBTC lost $166M.

upcoming.note: House and Senate control; results overnight into Wednesday.
Full ZK proof takes ~40–50 hours after the snapshot.
